newsitem.title: USA: U.S. pension unit sets maximum 1997 guarantees.
newsitem.headline: U.S. pension unit sets maximum 1997 guarantees.

text.p: The Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp. on Thursday said that the maximum benefit it will guarantee for retirees in underfunded single-employer defined benefit plans that end in 1997 will be $33,136 a year.
Maximum guarantees, which are adjusted annually, apply to workers who retire at age 65 or later. Payments are reduced for those retiring earlier or electing survivors benefits, the agency said.
It said that about 400,000 workers and retirees in 2,084 pension plans rely on the agency for their retirement income.
